title: Projection of a coordinate extension
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a set of indices in $ in n$, and let $z$ assign a value in the field with two elements to each index outside $J$. Extend $z$ to all indices in $ in n$ by assigning zero on $J$. Projecting this extension onto the indices outside $J$ recovers $z$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of $\fin n$
$z$ assigns an element of $\mathbb F_2$ to each index outside $J$
